items.title: Boeing (BA)’s $8.4 Billion Supplier Buyback Keeps Turning Up New Costs
items.summary: On September 3, The Wall Street Journal reported that The Boeing Company (NYSE:BA) has uncovered hundreds of millions of dollars in additional liabilities at Spirit AeroSystems beyond what it initially recognized after completing its $8.4 billion acquisition of the fuselage supplier in December 2025. Spirit’s assumed liabilities now exceed identifiable assets by roughly $1.9 billion. […]

items.title: Boeing Stock Skids As CEO Warns Of Further 737 Production Delays
items.summary: Boeing stock fell as much as 6% on Wednesday after CEO Kelly Ortberg said stable production of the 737 Max would take longer than expected.

items.title: Boeing’s Commercial Delays Threaten to Clip Its Wings
items.summary: Boeing is still pumping out more passenger planes than a year ago, but executives warned that a handful of threats loom on the horizon.  "We are not stable yet at 47 a month," Ortberg said at an investor conference Wednesday.  Regulatory work on the troubled 777X model could also "spill into next year" due to engine certification issues, Ortberg said.

items.title: Why Boeing Stock Is Sliding
items.summary: Boeing  stock dropped in late trading Wednesday after management made comments at an investor conference.  Production of the 737 MAX was “not stable at 47 a month,” said CEO Kelly Ortberg while speaking at a Morgan Stanley conference.  It was taking a little longer than expected to ramp and stabilize production, he added, with wing production an issue.
